description: The photograph depicts a wide view of a dry, semi-arid grassland landscape under a partly cloudy sky. In the immediate foreground, dry, straw-coloured grass is visible, along with two wooden fence posts connected by wire. The middle ground extends into a vast area of similar dry grassland, interspersed with numerous low, sparse shrubs or bushes, and a few larger, scattered broadleaf trees with green canopies. The background features a series of rolling hills and mountains, some showing patches of denser, yet still sparse, vegetation, consistent with scrub or transitional woodland. The overall environment appears dry, typical of Mediterranean dry grasslands.
